#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <numeric>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

void solve() {
    int N;
    cin >> N;
    string str;
    cin >> str;
    vector<int> b(N);
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        cin >> b[i];
    }

    vector<int> cnt(26, 0);
    int move = 0;
    int res = accumulate(b.begin(), b.end(), 0);

    for (int i = 0; i < N / 2; ++i) {
        if (str[i] == str[N - i - 1]) {
            cnt[str[i] - 'a']++;
            move++;
            res -= min(b[i], b[N - i - 1]);
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < 26; ++i) {
        if (cnt[i] > move / 2) {
            int left = cnt[i] * 2 - move;
            vector<int> pos;
            for (int j = 0; j < N / 2; ++j) {
                if (str[j] != str[N - j - 1]) {
                    if (!(str[N - j - 1] - 'a' == i || str[j] - 'a' == i)) {
                        pos.push_back(min(b[N - j - 1], b[j]));
                    }
                }
            }
            sort(pos.begin(), pos.end());
            for (int j = 0; j < left; ++j) {
                res -= pos[j];
            }
        }
    }

    cout << res << endl;
}

int main() {
    solve();
    return 0;
}
